"\n\nThe performances of <UserName>'s club side have come under scrutiny since his appointment as the new <TeamName1> national coach. Sometimes the life of a reporter is akin to getting water out of a rock. One such occasion is the situation developing between <TeamName> and <FullPlayerName>. It seems fair to conclude that <PlayerName> is angling for more money, a lot more money, and if he's not going to be offered the sum he is looking for then having a few clubs waiting in the wings is a nice plan B. But that's just the cynic in me writing.

Dear Mr. <PlayerFirstName1>,

It's come to our attention lately that your conduct on the field of play has been less than satisfactory. I am of course referring to your language. The blueness of its nature reflects badly on us as a team and you as a person. You should always remember that in an age where we have multiple cameras, microphones and TV replays everything you do is visible and possibly audible.

We understand the frustration you no doubt felt at times but please try and keep a cooler head. Continuing down the same path could lead to a ban and possibly other sanctions from the board. It's in all our interests that you calm yourself down a bit.

Cheers,
Assistant Manager
